description: Agent Education: submit an enrollment verification letter with the registrar record: the letter with its institution, student, student id, the day issued, the date it certifies, the enrollment status (enrolled, not enrolled, on leave, withdrawn or graduated), the program, the start and expected end dates and the standing (full time, three-quarter time, half time, less than half time or part time); the registrar record with its institution, student, student id, status, program, start and end dates, standing, the credits enrolled for the period the letter certifies, the credits the institution counts as full time and any withdrawal date. The signed report gives the letter and the record, the status, program and standing on each side read as matching or differing, the credits enrolled against the full-time threshold, and the start and end dates on each side with the certified date read inside or outside the recorded enrollment, and counts them, and names a divergent letter: a status unlike the record, a standing unlike the record, full-time standing on fewer credits than the full-time threshold, a program unlike the record and a start or end date unlike the record; then a certified date outside the recorded enrollment, a student name or id unlike the record and an institution named otherwise, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No status on either side, a standing the record does not state with no credits and threshold, a program on one side only, or a date the record does not state leaves the letter unverified. An end date before its start date is refused. Three-quarter, half and less-than-half time each read as part time beside it. This reads a student’s enrollment letter against the registrar record: wever_onboarding-record-check reads the record a new agent’s onboarding leaves behind against what is live, and wever_onboarding-identity-check reads a new agent’s identity at joining time, while the enrollment check reads a student’s status, program, dates and standing as stated against the registrar record. Verdict edu_enrollment_divergent, edu_enrollment_partial, edu_enrollment_unverified or edu_enrollment_consistent. POST /api/edu-enrollment-check. Reads the education paperwork supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only, with no admissions decision, accreditation judgment, aid eligibility decision or evaluation of academic quality or of any person’s ability, and the paperwork stays in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Education reads supplied education paperwork for consistency between documents: a transcript, a diploma or degree certificate, an enrollment verification letter, an education-issued certificate, a course completion record, a transfer credit evaluation, a financial aid award letter and a test score report. Beside it, the Agent Learning checks such as wever_learning-transfer-check read an agent’s own lessons and learning reports, not human education records, while an education check reads no agent lesson; wever_certification-evidence-check reads company certification, compliance and license claims such as ISO 27001, SOC 2 and PCI DSS against the evidence offered for them for DiligenceOps, and those claims stay there; and agent credentials stay with wever_credential-requirements-check, which reads whether a listing discloses its credential requirements before payment, and wever_onboarding-credential-check, which reads the credentials issued to a new agent. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-education-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-education/.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

as_of.description: The date the letter certifies, such as 2026-06-12.

credits.description: Credits enrolled for the period the letter certifies.

full_time_credits.description: The credits the institution counts as full time.
